notes: Only Letter Garden runtime and explicitly exported classic APIs are included. No island canvas Game.js, index.html, or src/world material.
Classic exports remain available in source; this catalog flags them as classic rather than implying they're current screen assets.
Some variants are procedural or data-derived, so they are listed as IDs/rules where the source defines them rather than as raster files.
Scale/anchor concerns are code hypotheses only; no visual mismatch is asserted.
